### About me

I am a senior biostatistician and data analyst with training in physics (BSc) and statistics (BSc, MSc, and PhD). From 2009, I have been working in statistics applied to environmental epidemiology at [ISGlobal](https://www.isglobal.org/en/researchers/-/profiles/18534) (former CREAL - Centre for Research in Environmental Epidemiology). I collaborate in several research programs (mainly air pollution, climate, radiation, and statistical methodology). I perform statistical data analyses under different study designs such as cohorts, case-control, cross-sectional, randomized experiments or exposure-outcome time series, as well as simulation studies. At methodological level, I have been working on some problems such as the integration of multiple imputation technique in cluster analysis, the interpretation of and software implementation for regression models with transformed variables, the assessment of interactions in the exposome-health association, the design of observational longitudinal studies, or the multi-zone time series analysis. I also provide statistical supervision to other statisticians, technicians, and PhD and MSc students. I have co-authored 40 [articles](publications.qmd) ([h-index = 24](https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=57201227197)) in statistical or epidemiological international journals (88% in Q1), 4 of them as first author and one as co-last author. I have also created and published a number of [R packages](software.qmd) and a web-app in R-shiny.

I love teaching. I am Associate Lecturer at the [Department of Mathematics](https://www.uab.cat/en/mathematics) at UAB where I am responsible for the implementation and teaching of several subjects on applications of statistics in the health sciences as well as the supervision of BSc and MSc theses. In addition, I provide training in R and statistical methods. See details in the [Teaching](teaching.qmd) section.

Previously, I was working for 14 years as civil servant mathematics teacher in high school. I have been on voluntary leave since 2009.

### Education

- PhD in Statistics (Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya, 2026)
- MSc in Statistics (Universitat de Barcelona - Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya, 2012). Best academic record of the promotion
- BSc in Statistics (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona, 2007). Extraordinary End-of-Degree Award for the best academic record
- BSc in Physics (Universitat de Barcelona, 1994)

### Professional experience

- Statistician & Data Analyst at ISGlobal (former CREAL) since October 2009
- Associate Lecturer at Department of Mathematics, Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona since February 2008
- External collaborator in [Servei d'Estadística Aplicada](https://www.uab.cat/en/applied-statistics-service) (UAB) since 2012
- Freelance statistical consultant and R instructor since 2007
- Secondary school mathematics teacher as civil servant of the Spanish Administration since September 1995. On voluntary leave since September 2009. [Personal website](http://www.xtec.cat/~jbarrera/index.htm)
